responseText:
I can do that, but I need your confirmation and a few details first — I’m not allowed to change or delete your mail without an explicit, unambiguous instruction with the exact scope and operation.

Please tell me (or confirm one of the options below):

1) Action (pick one)
   - Archive (moves messages out of Inbox into All Mail; recoverable, not visible in Inbox)
   - Delete (moves to Trash; deleted permanently after ~30 days — less reversible)

2) Scope (pick one or give a date)
   - All messages from noreply@transitalerts.net
   - Only messages in Inbox from noreply@transitalerts.net
   - Only messages older than X days (suggest 30 / 60 / 90)
   - Only messages before a specific date (e.g., before 2025-01-01)

3) One-time vs automated
   - One-time cleanup now
   - Also create a filter to automatically archive or delete future messages from that sender

Example confirmation you can copy/paste to approve an action:
   "Yes — archive all messages from noreply@transitalerts.net in my Inbox older than 90 days, one-time. Also create a filter to auto-archive future messages."

If you prefer, I can instead give step-by-step instructions so you can run this yourself, or show a preview of how many messages match before taking any action. Which would you like?
